C0522.title: Insider Greed: Changsha Executive and Group Steal Source Code to Sell Pirated Software, All Arrested
C0522.summary: Min, a former software service director at an IT company in Changsha, conspired with current and former employees to steal the company's complete software technical materials. They altered and repackaged the code to produce counterfeit software, selling it at low prices for profit.
